b1-magyarsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarians Beyond the Border
b1-magyarsag-01.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks what the Fundamental Law says about Hungarians who live outside Hungary.
b1-magyarsag-01.prompt: Tell the official what Article D of the Fundamental Law says about Hungarians living beyond the borders.
cues: Say which article you mean
Say what Hungary bears for these Hungarians
b1-magyarsag-01.target: Az Alaptörvény D) cikke szerint Magyarország felelősséget visel a határain kívül élő magyarok sorsáért.
b1-magyarsag-01.english: According to Article D of the Fundamental Law, Hungary bears responsibility for the fate of Hungarians living beyond its borders.
b1-magyarsag-01.canDo: I can say that Hungary bears responsibility for Hungarians who live beyond its borders.

b1-magyarsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Regions Abroad
b1-magyarsag-02.scenario: On a visit to a museum exhibition about the Carpathian Basin, the guide asks you where Hungarians live in the neighbouring countries.
b1-magyarsag-02.prompt: Tell the guide in which country the largest Hungarian community lives and where in Komárom you can study in Hungarian.
cues: Say the country and the region
Say which university in Komárom
b1-magyarsag-02.target: A legnagyobb magyar közösség Romániában él, főként Erdélyben. Komáromban a Selye János Egyetemen magyarul is lehet tanulni.
b1-magyarsag-02.english: The largest Hungarian community lives in Romania, mainly in Transylvania. In Komárom you can also study in Hungarian at the Selye János University.
b1-magyarsag-02.canDo: I can identify the historic regions of the Carpathian Basin and their Hungarian communities.

b1-magyarsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Weekend School
b1-magyarsag-03.scenario: You visit a Hungarian weekend school abroad, and the teacher asks what you know about Hungarians in the diaspora.
b1-magyarsag-03.prompt: Tell the teacher what the weekend schools do and which institutions were founded overseas.
cues: Say what the weekend schools help with
Say which institutions were founded overseas
b1-magyarsag-03.target: A hétvégi magyar iskolák segítik a gyermekek anyanyelvi fejlődését. A tengerentúlon Magyar Házak és cserkészcsapatok is létrejöttek.
b1-magyarsag-03.english: Weekend Hungarian schools help the children's native-language development. Hungarian Houses and scout troops were also founded overseas.
b1-magyarsag-03.canDo: I can describe Hungarian diaspora communities across Europe, the Americas, and Australia.

b1-magyarsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The V4 and the EU
b1-magyarsag-04.scenario: At a museum exhibition about Central Europe, the guide asks you about the Visegrád Four and the European Union.
b1-magyarsag-04.prompt: Tell the guide which four countries form the V4 and when Hungary became a member of the EU.
cues: Name the four countries
Say the date Hungary joined the EU
b1-magyarsag-04.target: A V4 tagjai Magyarország, Lengyelország, Csehország és Szlovákia. Magyarország 2004. május elsején lett az Európai Unió tagja.
b1-magyarsag-04.english: The V4 members are Hungary, Poland, Czechia and Slovakia. Hungary became a member of the European Union on 1 May 2004.
b1-magyarsag-04.canDo: I can name the four V4 countries and say when Hungary joined the European Union.

b1-magyarsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Simplified Naturalisation
b1-magyarsag-05.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks who can apply in the simplified procedure and what 4 June is.
b1-magyarsag-05.prompt: Tell the official who can ask for simplified naturalisation and what 4 June is.
cues: Say who can apply
Say what 4 June is called
b1-magyarsag-05.target: Egyszerűsített honosítást kérhet, akinek magyar felmenője van, és tud magyarul. Június negyedike a Nemzeti Összetartozás Napja.
b1-magyarsag-05.english: Someone who has a Hungarian ancestor and speaks Hungarian can ask for simplified naturalisation. 4 June is the Day of National Togetherness.
b1-magyarsag-05.canDo: I can understand the legal process of simplified naturalization for people of Hungarian ancestry.

b1-magyarsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarians Around the World
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.scenario: In a conversation with a Hungarian teacher before your citizenship interview, she asks you to sum up what you have learnt about Hungarians abroad.
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher where Hungarians live outside Hungary and how someone with a Hungarian ancestor can become a citizen.
cues: Say where Hungarians live abroad
Say how a descendant can become a citizen
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.target: Magyarok élnek a szomszédos országokban és a diaszpórában is. Akinek magyar felmenője van, egyszerűsített honosítást kérhet.
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.english: Hungarians live in the neighbouring countries and in the diaspora as well. Someone who has a Hungarian ancestor can ask for simplified naturalisation.
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about where Hungarians live beyond the border and abroad, and how people of Hungarian descent can become citizens.

b1-allampolgarsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Becoming a Citizen by Birth
b1-allampolgarsag-01.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks how a child becomes a Hungarian citizen.
b1-allampolgarsag-01.prompt: Tell the official when a child becomes a Hungarian citizen at birth and whether dual citizenship is recognised.
cues: Say what the parents must be
Say whether dual citizenship is recognised
b1-allampolgarsag-01.target: A gyermek születésével magyar állampolgár lesz, ha legalább az egyik szülője magyar állampolgár. A magyar jog elismeri a kettős állampolgárságot.
b1-allampolgarsag-01.english: A child becomes a Hungarian citizen at birth if at least one parent is a Hungarian citizen. Hungarian law recognises dual citizenship.
b1-allampolgarsag-01.canDo: I can explain how Hungarian citizenship is acquired by birth (jus sanguinis) and naturalization.

b1-allampolgarsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Voting and Petitions
b1-allampolgarsag-02.scenario: At a museum exhibition about democracy, the guide asks you about the rights of Hungarian citizens.
b1-allampolgarsag-02.prompt: Tell the guide who has the right to vote and where a citizen can turn with a request.
cues: Say who may vote
Say where a request can be sent
b1-allampolgarsag-02.target: Minden nagykorú magyar állampolgárnak joga van szavazni. Kérelemmel vagy panasszal fordulhatnak a hatóságokhoz.
b1-allampolgarsag-02.english: Every adult Hungarian citizen has the right to vote. They can turn to the authorities with a request or a complaint.
b1-allampolgarsag-02.canDo: I can articulate fundamental constitutional rights (voting, petition, peaceful assembly).

b1-allampolgarsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Duties of a Citizen
b1-allampolgarsag-03.scenario: A Hungarian teacher is preparing you for the citizenship interview and asks about citizens' duties.
b1-allampolgarsag-03.prompt: Tell the teacher what everyone must pay and whose duty it is to protect the environment.
cues: Say what everyone pays according to income
Say who must protect the environment
b1-allampolgarsag-03.target: Mindenki a jövedelme szerint köteles adót fizetni. A környezetvédelem az állam és mindenki kötelessége.
b1-allampolgarsag-03.english: Everyone must pay tax according to their income. Environmental protection is the duty of the state and of everyone.
b1-allampolgarsag-03.canDo: I can explain constitutional duties: public taxation (közteherviselés), defense, and schooling.

b1-allampolgarsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Citizenship Ceremony
b1-allampolgarsag-04.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks what happens at the end of the procedure.
b1-allampolgarsag-04.prompt: Tell the official where the oath can be taken and what the oath-taker receives.
cues: Say where the oath can be taken
Say what the new citizen receives
b1-allampolgarsag-04.target: Az esküt a polgármester előtt lehet letenni, külföldön a külképviseleten. Az új állampolgárok átveszik a honosítási okiratot.
b1-allampolgarsag-04.english: The oath can be taken before the mayor, and abroad at a diplomatic mission. The new citizens receive the naturalisation document.
b1-allampolgarsag-04.canDo: I can say what the citizenship oath and pledge are and where they are taken.

b1-allampolgarsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Citizenship Exam
b1-allampolgarsag-05.scenario: A Hungarian teacher asks you what the constitutional basics exam is like.
b1-allampolgarsag-05.prompt: Tell the teacher what language the exam is in and what you studied for it.
cues: Say what language the exam is in
Say one topic you studied
b1-allampolgarsag-05.target: A vizsgát magyarul kell letenni. Az Alaptörvényt és az államszervezetet tanultam.
b1-allampolgarsag-05.english: The exam has to be taken in Hungarian. I studied the Fundamental Law and the state organisation.
b1-allampolgarsag-05.canDo: I can say what the constitutional basics exam covers and that it is taken in Hungarian.

b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Citizenship Interview
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.scenario: In a practice interview, the official asks what you have learnt about being a Hungarian citizen.
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official one right and one duty of a Hungarian citizen.
cues: Say one right
Say one duty
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.target: Minden nagykorú magyar állampolgárnak joga van szavazni. Mindenki köteles a jövedelme szerint adót fizetni.
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.english: Every adult Hungarian citizen has the right to vote. Everyone must pay tax according to their income.
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.canDo: I can say how Hungarian citizenship is acquired, which rights and duties citizens have, and what the oath is.

b1-kormanyablak-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Waiting for My Number
b1-kormanyablak-01.scenario: You are Péter at the government window in Budapest. You booked an appointment for Friday morning at nine, and you have drawn a queue number at the ticket machine. A colleague who is waiting next to you asks why you are here so early. Say that you booked an appointment and that you are waiting for your number to be called.
b1-kormanyablak-01.prompt: Tell the person next to you about your appointment and your queue number.
cues: Say that you booked an appointment for Friday morning
Say that you drew a queue number and are waiting to be called
b1-kormanyablak-01.target: Időpontot foglaltam péntek reggel kilenc órára. Húztam egy sorszámot, és várom, hogy szólítsák a számomat.
b1-kormanyablak-01.english: I booked an appointment for Friday morning at nine. I drew a queue number and I am waiting for them to call my number.
b1-kormanyablak-01.canDo: I can say that I booked an appointment for a day and time at the government window.

b1-kormanyablak-02.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Window with My Documents
b1-kormanyablak-02.scenario: You are Péter at window twelve. The clerk asks for your documents. Say that your identity card expires next month and that you have the address registration form with you.
b1-kormanyablak-02.prompt: Tell the clerk about your identity card and show the address registration form.
cues: Say that the validity of your identity card ends next month
Say that here is the address registration form
b1-kormanyablak-02.target: A személyazonosító igazolványom érvényességi ideje a jövő hónapban lejár. Itt van a lakcímbejelentő lap.
b1-kormanyablak-02.english: The validity period of my identity card expires next month. Here is the address registration form.
b1-kormanyablak-02.canDo: I can say that my identity card expires next month and that I have my address registration form.

b1-kormanyablak-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Ügyfélkapu Is For
b1-kormanyablak-03.scenario: You are Péter. After the visit at the government window a colleague asks what the Ügyfélkapu is for. Explain that you can arrange official matters online with it and that you log in with two-factor authentication.
b1-kormanyablak-03.prompt: Tell your colleague what you can do with the Ügyfélkapu and how you log in.
cues: Say that you can arrange official matters online with the Ügyfélkapu
Say that you log in with two-factor authentication
b1-kormanyablak-03.target: Az Ügyfélkapu segítségével hatósági ügyeket intézhetek online. Kétlépcsős azonosítással lépek be.
b1-kormanyablak-03.english: With the Ügyfélkapu I can arrange official matters online. I log in with two-factor authentication.
b1-kormanyablak-03.canDo: I can say what the Ügyfélkapu portal is used for and that I log in with two-factor authentication.

b1-kormanyablak-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Submitting an Application
b1-kormanyablak-04.scenario: You are Péter at the government window. The clerk explains how to apply for an official certificate. Tell the clerk that you submit the application in writing on the form and that you attach the original documents.
b1-kormanyablak-04.prompt: Tell the clerk how you submit your application.
cues: Say that you submit the application in writing on the appropriate form
Say that you attach the original copy of the documents
b1-kormanyablak-04.target: A kérelmet írásban, a megfelelő nyomtatványon nyújtom be. Csatolom az összes irat eredeti példányát.
b1-kormanyablak-04.english: I submit the application in writing on the appropriate form. I attach the original copy of all documents.
b1-kormanyablak-04.canDo: I can say that I submit an application in writing on a form and attach the original documents.

b1-kormanyablak-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Notice About Missing Documents
b1-kormanyablak-05.scenario: You are Péter. You received a notice about missing documents for your application, and you tell the clerk at the government window what you will do. Say that you received the notice and that you will supply the missing documents within the deadline.
b1-kormanyablak-05.prompt: Tell the clerk what you will do about the notice.
cues: Say that you received a notice to remedy deficiencies
Say that you will supply the missing documents within the deadline
b1-kormanyablak-05.target: Hiánypótlási felhívást kaptam. A megadott határidőn belül pótolom a hiányzó iratokat.
b1-kormanyablak-05.english: I received a notice to remedy deficiencies. I will supply the missing documents within the stated deadline.
b1-kormanyablak-05.canDo: I can say what happens when documents are missing from an application.

b1-kormanyablak-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Visit to the Government Window
b1-kormanyablak-consolidation.scenario: You are Péter. A colleague asks how your visit to the government window went. Say that the procedure took only about twenty minutes and that you asked for a new identity card and reported your new address.
b1-kormanyablak-consolidation.prompt: Tell your colleague about your visit.
cues: Say how long the procedure took
Say that you asked for a new identity card and reported your new address
b1-kormanyablak-consolidation.target: Az ügyintézés alig húsz percig tartott. Kértem az új személyit, és bejelentettem az új lakcímemet.
b1-kormanyablak-consolidation.english: The procedure took barely twenty minutes. I asked for the new ID card and reported my new address.
b1-kormanyablak-consolidation.canDo: I can follow and retell a short account of renewing an ID card and registering a new address.

b1-alberlet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Viewing the Flat
b1-alberlet-01.scenario: You are Anna. You are viewing a furnished flat in Budapest with Kovács úr, the owner. He asks what you think. Say that the flat is furnished and in good condition.
b1-alberlet-01.prompt: Tell Kovács úr what you think of the flat.
cues: Say that the flat is furnished
Say that it is in good condition
b1-alberlet-01.target: A lakás bútorozott, és jó állapotban van.
b1-alberlet-01.english: The flat is furnished, and it is in good condition.
b1-alberlet-01.canDo: I can describe a flat as furnished and in good condition.

b1-alberlet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Lease and the Deposit
b1-alberlet-02.scenario: You are Anna. Kovács úr proposes the contract terms. Say how long the lease is for and how much deposit you pay.
b1-alberlet-02.prompt: Tell Kovács úr the length of the lease and the deposit.
cues: Say the lease is for one year, a fixed term
Say you pay a two-month deposit
b1-alberlet-02.target: Egyéves határozott időre kötjük meg a szerződést. Kéthavi kauciót fizetek.
b1-alberlet-02.english: We conclude the contract for a fixed term of one year. I pay a two-month deposit.
b1-alberlet-02.canDo: I can say how long a lease is for and how much deposit I pay.

b1-alberlet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Handover Protocol
b1-alberlet-03.scenario: You are Anna on the day you sign. Kovács úr asks what you record in the handover protocol. Say that you record the readings of the electricity and gas meters.
b1-alberlet-03.prompt: Tell Kovács úr what you write in the protocol.
cues: Say that you draw up a protocol
Say that you record the electricity and gas meter readings
b1-alberlet-03.target: Jegyzőkönyvet veszünk fel. Rögzítjük a villanyóra és a gázóra állását.
b1-alberlet-03.english: We draw up a protocol. We record the electricity meter and gas meter readings.
b1-alberlet-03.canDo: I can say what is recorded in the handover protocol.

b1-alberlet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Rent and Common Cost
b1-alberlet-04.scenario: You are Anna. Kovács úr explains the house rules and costs. Say when you pay the rent and what the common cost includes.
b1-alberlet-04.prompt: Tell Kovács úr what you have understood about the payments.
cues: Say the rent is paid by the tenth day of each month
Say the common cost includes the rubbish collection
b1-alberlet-04.target: A bérleti díjat minden hónap tizedik napjáig fizetem meg. Kovács úr elmagyarázta a közös költség rendjét.
b1-alberlet-04.english: I pay the rent by the tenth of every month. Mr Kovács explained how the common costs work.
b1-alberlet-04.canDo: I can say when the rent is paid and what the common cost includes.

b1-alberlet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Ending the Lease
b1-alberlet-05.scenario: You are a tenant talking to the owner about moving out. Say that you terminate the lease in writing and that the deposit comes back if there is no damage.
b1-alberlet-05.prompt: Tell the owner how the termination and the deposit work.
cues: Say that you terminate the contract in writing
Say that the deposit is returned if there is no damage
b1-alberlet-05.target: A szerződést írásban mondom fel. Kiköltözéskor a kaució visszajár, ha nincs kár.
b1-alberlet-05.english: I terminate the contract in writing. On moving out the deposit is returned if there is no damage.
b1-alberlet-05.canDo: I can say that a termination must be in writing.

b1-alberlet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My New Flat
b1-alberlet-consolidation.scenario: You are Anna. A friend asks how the day of moving in went. Say that you signed the contract and paid the first rent and the deposit.
b1-alberlet-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what you did on the day you moved in.
cues: Say that you signed the contract
Say that you transferred the first rent and the deposit
b1-alberlet-consolidation.target: Aláírtuk a szerződést. Átutaltam az első havi bérleti díjat és a kauciót.
b1-alberlet-consolidation.english: We signed the contract. I transferred the first month's rent and the deposit.
b1-alberlet-consolidation.canDo: I can retell how a tenant signs a lease and moves into a flat.
